question: A train running at a speed of 126 km/h crosses a pole in 6 seconds. The length of the train is:
solution:
**Given:**

A train running at a speed of 126 km/h crosses a pole in 6 seconds.

**Concept used:**

Distance = speed × time 

**Calculation:**

126 km/h = 126 × 5/18

⇒ 5 × 7 = 35 m/s

So, in 6 seconds train covers his own length = 35 × 6

⇒ 210 m

**∴ The length of the train is 210 m.**
